---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## What do you want?

A clear and concise description of the feature.

## Why is it useful?

Explain the problem you're trying to solve.

## How should it work?

Describe the user-facing behavior you'd expect. UI mockups, ASCII art, or links to reference apps welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why this one is better.

## Scope

- [ ] Affects chat UI
- [ ] Affects provider / model management
- [ ] Affects settings / preferences
- [ ] Affects export / import
- [ ] Affects Siri shortcuts
- [ ] Other: ___
